item.title: Why is there no WPL match being played today?
item.description: No Women's Premier League match is scheduled today. The opening leg of WPL 2026 at the DY Patil Stadium came to a close with a dramatic double-header that summed up the intensity of the competition so far.

item.title: WATCH: Virat Kohli’s playful gesture steals the show after Daryl Mitchell’s ODI century in Indore
item.description: Virat Kohli playfully pushed Daryl Mitchell off the field. Mitchell smashed a brilliant century in the ODI series decider against India.

item.title: IND vs NZ: Fans fume as Shreyas Iyer’s reckless shot leads to soft dismissal in ODI series decider
item.description: Fans' frustration reached a breaking point following Shreyas Iyer's dismissal during a mammoth 338-run chase in Indore ODI. Iyer's brief stay ended in a moment of poor shot selection that left the Indore crowd in pin-drop silence and sparked a firestorm on social media.

item.title: IND vs NZ [WATCH]: Virat Kohli reacts furiously after unexpected fielding error in Indore ODI
item.description: Virat Kohli seemed frustrated with himself after rare fielding mistake during the ODI series-decider against New Zealand. The third ODI reached a critical juncture after India began their 338-run chase.

item.title: IND vs NZ [WATCH]: ‘Pushpa’ fever hits Indore as Nitish Kumar Reddy unleashes iconic celebration after maiden ODI fifty
item.description: Nitish Kumar Reddy hammered a gritty maiden ODI half-century against New Zealand in a high-pressure series finale at the Holkar Stadium. Nitish was caught for a well-made 53 off 57 balls, leaving Virat Kohli to shoulder the burden once again.

item.title: WPL 2026: Harleen Deol opens up about the ‘retired out’ incident
item.description: Harleen Deol addressed controversy over her WPL 2026 retired out moment. Deol was adjudged Player of the Match for her fiery unbeaten 64 off 39 deliveries.

item.title: Fans react after Virat Kohli’s 54th ODI century goes in vain as New Zealand seal historic series win over India in Indore
item.description: The heroic efforts of Virat Kohli and Harshit Rana proved to be in vain as New Zealand clinched their first-ever ODI series win on Indian soil. Despite Kohli’s magnificent 54th ODI century and Rana's fearless maiden fifty, India fell short by 41 runs

item.title: Will Chinnaswamy Stadium host IPL 2026 matches? KSCA provides big update
item.description: No cricket has been played at the Chinnaswamy Stadium since June last year. KSCA has provided a big update on conducting IPL 2026 matches.

item.title: WATCH: Vaibhav Suryavanshi plucks a stunning catch during IND vs BAN clash at U19 World Cup 2026
item.description: Vaibhav Suryavanshi’s miraculous boundary-line catch put India on top against Bangladesh in U-19 World Cup. Vihaan Malhotra’s four-wicket haul propelled India U-19 to a thrilling 18-run DLS victory over Bangladesh.
